memories.text:
Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cutoff 80 cm, slightly increased). 
- Vitamin B12 deficiency: status – symptomatic with fatigue, serum B12 low; plan – start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, take after breakfast; repeat B12 in 3 months.
- Epilepsy: status – seizure-free on levetiracetam 500 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD; plan – continue current regimen, check serum sodium and creatinine.
- Atrial fibrillation: status – paroxysmal AF, on apixaban 5 mg BD and bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD; plan – add warfarin 5 mg OD targeting INR 2-3 after baseline INR, monitor INR twice weekly.
Diet advice: Breakfast – low‑salt, whole‑grain cereal with milk; Lunch – vegetarian dal, rice, steamed vegetables; Dinner – light soup, chapati, salad.
Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).
